## ✅ Contribution & Quality Checklist

Before submitting, please ensure your contribution meets all repository standards:

- [ ] **100% Free / Permanent Free Tier:** No credit card required upfront, no 7/14-day expiring trial, and primary features are freely accessible.
- [ ] **Clean Canonical URL:** Completely stripped of tracking parameters (`?utm_*`), affiliate IDs, referral codes, or session tokens.
- [ ] **Alphabetical Ordering:** Resource is placed in strict alphabetical order within its designated table.
- [ ] **Table Syntax Conformity:** Adheres to the established markdown table schema (`| **[Name](url)** | Description | Focus / Tags | Link |`).
- [ ] **High Pedagogical Value:** Provides genuine educational or workflow utility to frontend developers and designers.
- [ ] **Actively Maintained:** Has seen updates, commits, or active usage in the last 1–2 years.
- [ ] **Link Health Verified:** Manually verified that the URL returns HTTP 200 without broken redirects or SSL issues.
